data.locator: BMSCH Is a Nationally Accredited Pediatric Trauma Center
data.source_setting: Pediatric trauma/PICU service at The Bristol-Myers Squibb Children's Hospital at RWJUH, New Brunswick
data.source_period: Undated current public service page; retrieved 2026-10-10.
data.value: Nationally accredited pediatric trauma center; PICU described as equipped for pediatric traumatic injury
data.source_evidence_basis: The BMSCH PICU page says the hospital is one of three nationally accredited pediatric trauma centers in New Jersey and describes the PICU as equipped for pediatric traumatic injury.
data.limitations: RWJUH ED pages separately state Level II pediatric trauma verification, while a RWJBH system pediatric trauma page states Level I. This record avoids assigning a level pending authoritative reconciliation. Designation does not establish live staffing or capacity.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use only as pediatric trauma capability context; do not assign a trauma level or imply current readiness based on this record.
